instruction: Look at seed_ss_gui_06_hex_plate.dxf and continue editing that drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Use the construction marks in the file to create a regular hexagonal plate with top and bottom edges horizontal and circumradius 40. Add one center hole of diameter 20. Add one diameter 6 hole near each left and right vertex; each hole center must be horizontally aligned with the corresponding vertex and inset 12 from that vertex. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_06.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
